sections.explanation: Equal additive steps produce a line; equal multiplicative factors produce exponential change. In N=N₀a^t, increasing t by1 multiplies N by a. A power law y=kx^p behaves differently: multiplying x by a factor multiplies y by that factor raised to p. log_b(x) is the exponent giving x, with x>0,b>0,b≠1. Products become sums of logs, quotients differences, powers factors. Never take the logarithm of a dimensional quantity directly: form a positive ratio to a reference quantity.
sections.worked: N/N₀=2^(−t/3) gives half-life3 time units. At t=6 the fraction is1/4. To reach1/10, t=−3 ln(0.1)/ln2≈9.97. For y/y₀=exp(kt), ln(y/y₀)=kt: a semilog representation is straight. For y/y₀=(x/x₀)^p, a log–log representation has slopep.
tasks: For y=3x², what is the output factor if x triples? Contrast doubling time in an exponential.
feedback: Factor9; exponential change is characterised by equal time increments, not generally by multiplying time.
